name: OpenColorIO
role: Colour-management engine for ACES and config-driven transforms; library plus ocio* CLI utilities
summary: Academy Software Foundation colour-management library. A config file defines colour spaces, looks and views; applications use the C++ or Python API (or the ocioconvert and ociocheck utilities) to transform pixels between them. Used inside OpenImageIO, Blender, Natron and most VFX tools. Strength: authoritative, config-driven ACES and scene-referred transforms; it processes colour, not files.
use_when: Converting between ACES, linear and display spaces from one shared config
Validating or authoring an OCIO config the whole pipeline will share
Over ad-hoc ImageMagick colourspace flags when transforms must match Blender or Natron
avoid_when: Reading, writing or resizing files: oiiotool or ImageMagick, which call OCIO
Simple sRGB to linear conversion: ImageMagick is enough
Browser display: use a canvas colour space, OCIO has no JS runtime here
notes: 2026-10-26: Homebrew opencolorio is at 2.6.0, matching upstream. The check_command ociocheck -h was not verified. The repo page fetched did not list bindings or CLIs; those are from general knowledge and should be confirmed against opencolorio.readthedocs.io.

assessment.rationale: Release v2.6.0 on 2026-10-01 from the project's release feed; Homebrew matches. Standard colour engine under the other A6 and DCC tools, with no peer.
